items.title: White House launches 'Trump TV' after ban on major news outlets
items.description: Days after President Trump barred reporters from three major news outlets from the White House, the administration has launched a 24/7 YouTube channel promising to put its "biggest moments all in one place."

items.title: RFK Jr.'s ethics disclosure reveals free travel and hefty book advances
items.description: Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s latest financial disclosure reveals he accepted free flights to Fiji and Greece and lucrative book advances.

items.title: Is President Trump the world's peacekeeper?
items.description: NPR's Mary Louise Kelly speaks with State Department spokesman Tommy Pigott about President Trump's speech to the United Nations and America's place in the world.

items.title: Trump's D.C. arch is now a military complex. Here's how that complicates things
items.description: The future of Trump's D.C. arch was already fraught. Then he rebranded it as a military complex. Experts say that only raises more legal and logistical questions.

items.title: The House Freedom Caucus has to transform — it could preview the GOP's post-Trump era
items.description: The conservative House Freedom Caucus grew in prominence alongside President Trump. Now they are considering what the future of their movement looks like.

items.title: Trump heads to the U.N. looking for wins after a rough week
items.description: The past couple of weeks have been particularly challenging for Trump with a series of legal and political setbacks.

items.title: A U.S. House race in Arizona could hinge on voters' opinion of the Big Beautiful Bill
items.description: The reelection campaign by a Republican congressman in Arizona could hinge on voter perceptions of last year's massive GOP-backed spending bill.

items.title: Trump's big weekend: The arch, Greenland, and media outlets banned from White House
items.description: President Trump's exertion of power over the press, Greenland and even the D.C. landscape are teeing up questions over the president's limits.

items.title: Many GOP candidates still echo Trump's 2020 claims. Lots of voters want to move on
items.description: While many Republican candidates, even in some critical tossup races, still back President Trump's baseless claims about election integrity, some GOP voters say they are ready to move on.

items.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico sue Trump after being barred from White House
items.description: Reporters from CNN, MS NOW and Politico say they were prevented from entering the White House grounds after President Trump announced plans to ban all three outlets.
